what.text: The site is Apple's own AirPods Pro 3 product section on apple.com.
AirPods Pro 3 is a consumer earbud with Hearing Test, Hearing Aid and Hearing Protection features, used with an iPhone or iPad.
The Hearing Aid feature has received FDA authorization. It is meant for people with perceived mild to moderate hearing loss.

where.text: The catalog entry is the overview page, which compares AirPods Pro 3 with AirPods 5 and links to all AirPods models.
The compare page lists AirPods 5, AirPods 4, AirPods Pro 3, AirPods Pro 2, AirPods Max, AirPods Max 2 and AirPods (2nd and 3rd generation), each with its own tech specs link.
The specs page holds the AirPods Pro 3 technical data and is the only model-level page in this section.

Documents are Apple environmental PDFs: the AirPods Pro 3 Product Environmental Report, the Regulated Substances Specification and the Environmental Progress Report 2026. No user guide or datasheet is linked.
The footnotes point to support.apple.com articles (120850, 120409, 123184) for Hearing Protection, cleaning and heart rate. The report does not list a support page.
The pages link to one iOS app, id 375380948, and no Android app.

summary.text: Apple's AirPods Pro 3 section on apple.com: a consumer earbud with a Hearing Aid feature (FDA-authorized), served as static HTML with five pages and no model-per-URL catalog.
